headline: Ravindra Energy Limited announces 1:9 rights issue at ₹101 per share
sum: Ravindra Energy Limited's Board approved a 1:9 rights equity issue at ₹101 per share, filed with NSE on 16 May 2026. No total corpus disclosed in the primary announcement.
implication: Rights issues under the Companies Act 2013 require shareholder approval within 30 days of Board clearance and carry preferential allotment mechanics; confirm whether this entity is ICDR-regulated or subject to sectoral caps (energy/renewables may trigger Ministry/SEBI pre-clearance).
detail: The Board of Directors of Ravindra Energy Limited, at a meeting on 16 May 2026, passed a resolution to issue equity shares on a rights basis at a ratio of 1 new share for every 9 existing shares held, priced at ₹101 per share. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) the same day. No prospectus, issue size, timeline for shareholder approval, or company background was disclosed in the primary NSE filing. The pricing and ratio suggest a modest capital raise, though the exact corpus remains undetermined until subscription data emerges.
